meta.name: batch-analysis
meta.description: Guide for multi-experiment batch operations: QC screening, batch download, comparison, and report generation across many ENCODE experiments simultaneously. Use when users need to process 5+ experiments together, create experiment comparison tables, perform batch quality checks, or generate summary reports. Trigger on: batch analysis, multiple experiments, bulk processing, experiment comparison, batch QC, multi-sample, batch download, experiment table, summary report, collection analysis.

copy.tagline: 批量处理多个实验的质控、下载、比较和报告生成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要同时处理多个ENCODE实验并生成汇总报告
copy.tagline_en: Batch process QC, download, comparison, and report generation for multiple experiments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to process multiple ENCODE experiments simultaneously and generate summary reports

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会指导你批量搜索、筛选、下载和比较多个 ENCODE 实验，并生成汇总报告。
howto.when: 当你需要同时处理 5 个以上 ENCODE 实验，或要求批量质控、比较、下载、生成汇总表时触发。

say.text: 帮我批量质控所有肝脏的 H3K27ac 实验。
say.note: Claude 会搜索并筛选出高质量实验。

say.text: 比较这 10 个 ChIP-seq 数据集的质量。
say.note: Claude 会构建兼容性矩阵并标记问题。

say.text: 批量下载胰腺 H3K27ac 的 bigWig 文件。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you to batch search, filter, download, and compare multiple ENCODE experiments, and generate summary reports.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to process 5+ ENCODE experiments simultaneously, or request batch QC, comparison, download, or summary table.

say_en.text: Batch QC all H3K27ac experiments in liver.
say_en.note: Claude will search and filter high-quality experiments.

say_en.text: Compare quality across these 10 ChIP-seq datasets.
say_en.note: Claude will build a compatibility matrix and flag issues.

say_en.text: Batch download bigWig files for pancreas H3K27ac.
